entities.summary: Germán Suárez Flamerich was the president of Venezuela from 1950 to 1952. Flamerich was a lawyer, college professor, diplomat and politician. He was president of the Government Junta from 1950 to 1952, after the assassination of Carlos Delgado Chalbaud.

entities.summary: Germán Suárez Flamerich was the president of Venezuela from 1950 to 1952. Flamerich was a lawyer, college professor, diplomat and politician. He was president of the Government Junta from 1950 to 1952, after the assassination of Carlos Delgado Chalbaud.
